item.title: Bahamian Drug Bust, BPL Outage, China Donation
item.ns0:title: Bahamian Drug Bust, BPL Outage, China Donation
item.description:
Tonight on Our News Weekend, a major drug bust in Grand Bahama leads to multiple arrests while police investigate a sensitive incident involving a local teenager. We examine the mounting financial toll on local businesses as frequent power outages disrupt charitable events and highlight a generous international donation for our public parks. Our team also sits down with a pioneering Bahamian medical expert and takes you on a vibrant cultural journey to Barbados for the Crop Over celebrations. Stay tuned for these headlines, a look at talented young Bahamians making their mark, and your complete weekend sports and weather updates.
